Saves
-----

Saves and the player's name are kept as the original's files FLAG0..FLAG9 and NAME.DEF in
saves/nova/ in this drawer (ENVARC:adv98x/nova/ when the drawer is write-protected), or in the
directory given with STORAGE=. Files from a PC-98 copy of the game can be put there and are
used as they are.
